sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Devesh Kumar Shukla,Kamlendra Tripathi Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Dr. Gautam Chowdhary,J.
Sri Mohit Kumar, learned counsel has filed his power on behalf of the opposite party no.2 today in the Court, which is taken on record.
Heard learned counsel for the first informant-applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and learned counsel for the accused-opposite party no.2.

The instant bail cancellation application has been moved on behalf of the informant for cancelling the bail granted to the accused-opposite party no.2 in Case Crime No.69 of 2022 under Section 376 I.P.C., Police Station Mahila Thana, District Saharanpur.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant-informant submits that the accused-opposite party no.2 was granted bail subject to the conditions contained in the bail order, however, the accused-opposite party no.2 has violated the conditions of the bail and is threatening the applicant to become hostile.

Apart from the aforesaid, the opposite party no.2 has criminal history of as many as five cases,
which has been explained in paragraph no.10 of the affidavit accompanying the application.
On the other hand, learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 has submitted that the opposite party no.2 has not violated any condition and is living peacefully and bald allegation of threatening has been levelled against the applicant only to cause harm and harassment to the applicant.
Learned A.G.A. submits that the informant has a remedy available under the Witness Protection Scheme Scheme, 2018 and thus the instant bail cancellation application may be disposed of in the light of protection granted to the witnesses under the Witness Protection Scheme, 2018.
In view of the submissions made by learned A.G.A., this Court is of the opinion, that the applicant has remedy available to her under Witness Protection Scheme, 2018, which scheme has been approved by Hon'ble Apex Court in Mahender Chawla and others Vs. Union of India reported in (2019) 14 SCC 615.

entities.text: Mahender Chawla and others Vs. Union of India reported in (2019) 14 SCC 615
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Accordingly, present bail cancellation application is disposed of with a direction, in case, the informant-applicant moves appropriate application on the proforma prescribed in the Witness Protection Scheme 2018 alongwith a certified copy of this order for redressal of her grievances, as raised in the instant bail cancellation application, before the competent authority as has been defined under Section 2 (c) of the Witness Protection Scheme, 2018 within a week from today, same shall be considered and decided as expeditiously as possible, preferably within a period of one month from date of filing such application, strictly in accordance with the Witness Protection Scheme 2018.

Order Date :- 18.9.2023 S.Ali  Smt Pinki vs State Of U.P. And Another on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/153361981/
